items.notes: One grey SNES-inspired Retroflag SUPERPi CASE photographed. Owner reports Raspberry Pi 3 installed, corrected earlier 2 GB recollection to 1 GB RAM, and says it is currently configured for retro gaming. Raspberry Pi board remains unphotographed; exact Pi 3 revision (Model B vs B+), operating system/emulators and working status untested. Official Raspberry Pi 3 B/B+ models specify 1 GB RAM.
